title: I want you to come
goal: Give an action its own doer with -mA and a possessive ending: Gelmeni istiyorum, Gelmenize sevindim, Otobüsün gelmesini bekliyoruz.

intro.text: When someone else does the action, use `-mA` + a possessive ending: *Gitmek istiyorum* (I want to go), but *Gitmeni istiyorum* (I want you to go: **your going**). Then add the case the verb needs: *Gelmenize sevindim*, *Gelmesini bekliyoruz*.

vocab.en: to be glad, to be happy (about: dative)
to be sad, to be sorry (about: dative)
to get angry, to be cross (at, about: dative)

exercises.label: *gelmek* + `-mA` + possessive + accusative, before *istiyor*: she wants me to come, you to come…
exercises.explain: The possessive names who comes; the accusative is what *istemek* needs. The third person adds n before it: *gelmesini*, *gelmelerini*.

exercises.question: How do you say **I want you to come**?

why.1: **I want to come**: with the bare infinitive, the one who wants is the one who comes.
why.2: **You want me to come**: *gelmemi* is my coming, *istiyorsun* is you want.

exercises.explain: *gel-me-n-i*: *-n* (your) names the one who comes, *-i* is the accusative that *istemek* needs.

exercises.en: I'm so glad you came to the party.

reject.why: Without a possessive, nothing says who came. **You** came: *gelmene* or *gelmenize*.

exercises.explain: *gel-me-n-e*: your coming (*-n*, or polite *-niz*), in the dative that *sevinmek* needs.

accept: My mother wants me to go to bed early.
My [mom|mum] wants me to go to bed early.
My [mother|mom|mum] wants me to go to sleep early.
My [mother|mom|mum] wants me to sleep early.

exercises.prompt: We are waiting for the bus to come.

reject.why: The doer of a verbal noun takes the genitive, like an owner: *otobüsün gelmesini*.

exercises.gloss: her going, as an object (I want her to go)
exercises.explain: *git-* doesn't soften: `-mA` starts with a consonant. Then *-si* (her) and the n of the third person before the accusative *-i*.

exercises.en: Her father didn't let her go.

exercises.text: You do not need to come.
accept: You do not have to come.

exercises.en: We were surprised that Ali didn't come.
exercises.explain: The doer of a verbal noun goes in the genitive: *Ali'nin gelmemesi*, Ali's not coming. *Şaşırmak* then adds the dative.

exercises.prompt: I am sorry you did not come.

reject.why: Without a possessive, nothing says who didn't come. **You** didn't: *gelmemene* or *gelmemenize*.

exercises.question: A colleague asks: *Bugün erken gitmeme izin verir misiniz?* What is she asking?
options: Will you let me leave early today?
Can I let you leave early today?

why.1: *Gitmeme* is **my leaving**: she is the one who wants to go.
why.2: She is asking for permission, not giving it: *izin verir misiniz?*, **will you allow?**

exercises.explain: *git-me-m-e izin vermek*: to allow **my** leaving, **to let me leave**. *İzin vermek* takes the dative.

exercises.en: She was very cross that I was late.
